info.title: Mane Man API: the ops console
info.description: mm-api on the ops console's host (docs/decisions/0026-hosts-and-surfaces.md), served at https://{host}/api/*, behind Cloudflare Access. Every call needs a valid Access token and is recorded in the audit log under its identity (docs/decisions/0031-access-and-audit.md). Every response carries an X-Request-Id header.

fields.description: invalid_request: the fields that failed validation, never their values; superseded: what changed under the caller.

version_id.description: Cloudflare Worker version ID serving this request.

version_tag.description: Tag given at upload: the git commit SHA in remote environments.

d1.description: ok: reachable and marked as this environment's database. unmarked: no identity row. mismatch: marked as another environment's database.

more.description: More than 20 match: narrow the search.

text.description: Any part of a name, or of a number typed any of the usual ways.

mobile.description: E.164, as ops need it to call or message.

known_since.description: When the person's record was first written.

address.description: The address visits go to now.

credits.description: Service visits left and when the soonest expires; null with none left.

visits.description: Upcoming soonest first; past newest first.

payments.description: Payments and refunds as one list, newest first.

access_notes.description: For the technician: gate code, parking and the like.

outcome.description: What FSM closed the visit as, a no-show being its own; null until it is closed.

stage.description: For a visit FSM has not closed: still to come, under way in its window, or over and waiting for FSM to close it. Null once FSM has closed it.

prepaid.description: Paid for ahead, or covered by a visit credit: board C1's Prepaid.

place.description: The saved address's area, city and pincode, else FSM's city and pincode.

date.description: India's calendar date it was made.

amount_ex_gst.description: In paise, before GST: the main figure.

gst_percent.description: The GST rate the amount includes.

visit.description: The visit it paid for, when known.

method.description: upi, card, netbanking and so on.

refunded_amount.description: In paise: refunds Razorpay has processed.

purpose.description: What it paid for: the visit, or a late fee.

at.description: When the client cancelled or moved the visit.

visit_started_at.description: When the visit was to start.

charge.description: Kept under the 24-hour rule, with its evidence: "cancelled 9:14 am, visit was 10 am".

no_show.description: The visit it paid for was one the client was not home for: how long we waited, and what ops ruled (LIFE-07).

decision.description: What ops ruled: undecided while they look at the evidence, charged, or waived.

waited_minutes.description: How long the technician waited at the door.

date.description: India's calendar date it was made.

amount_ex_gst.description: In paise, before GST: the main figure.

gst_percent.description: The GST rate the amount includes.

visit.description: The visit it paid for, when known.

destination.description: Where the money goes back to: the payment's method.

speed.description: normal (5 to 7 working days) or instant.

visits.description: Every visit done: a completed visit with a window.

first_fit_on.description: India's date. Null when no first fit is on record, which is not the same as none.

last_visit_on.description: India's date of the latest visit done.

spend.description: In paise: every payment captured, less what has gone back. A credit adds nothing.

replacement_due.description: When the piece now in wear falls due; null when the client is wearing none.

photos.description: Before then after, each in the design's angle order.

logged_at.description: When the opening was logged, by our clock.

before.description: Who opened them before, and when, the latest first.

state.description: not_given until the client first switches it on; withdrawn once they switch it back off.

notice_version.description: The notice the client saw when they last switched it.

deletion.description: Their latest deletion request. A processed one leaves no client to read.

visits.description: Visits to add, or, below nought, to take away.

reason.description: correction: given or taken in error; goodwill: given to make up for something.
Required to reject; kept with the decision (src/policy/decision-reasons.ts).
Required to reject; kept with the decision (src/policy/decision-reasons.ts).
Required either way, and kept with the decision (src/policy/decision-reasons.ts).

launch_on.description: India's date it starts; today if left out.

city.description: The city the jobs are narrowed to; null for all.

cities.description: The cities the board can be narrowed to.

sector.description: The area the visit's pincode is in, from the service area; else the address's locality, or the city.

person.description: Null for a visit with no client on our records, and for a client who has been erased.

badge.description: Never an amount: prepaid, credit, or free.

asked_window.description: The window the client asked for, from the Request behind the visit; null where nothing recorded one.

utilisation.description: Each column's utilisation, in per cent: the slots the day's jobs take, done or still to do, out of the slots of the technicians not on leave. Written to events daily as well.

leave.description: Leave ops recorded, clipped to this week. Not from FSM: its availability answers free time, not leave.

sector.description: The area the visit's pincode is in, from the service area; else the address's locality, or the city.

person.description: Null for a visit with no client on our records, and for a client who has been erased.

badge.description: Never an amount: prepaid, credit, or free.

untold.description: The latest move of this visit its client has not heard of: he has not agreed to WhatsApp, or the message was never sent. Ops call him, then POST /api/dispatch/moves/{id}/told.

name.description: In full, as the drawer heads it.

mobile.description: E.164, for WhatsApp and for a call.

whatsapp_visits.description: His latest word on WhatsApp about his visits is yes, so a move's new window reaches him there.

referred_by.description: Who invited him, by name; null when he came on his own.

DispatchRoom.description: Each technician's day with a window the job would land in, by the check a move runs. A day not listed has none. Not where the job already is.

client_notice.description: messaged: the new window was queued to go on WhatsApp; call: the client has not agreed to WhatsApp about his visits, so ops call him, and a task waits until they say they have; unchanged: only the technician changed, so there was nothing to tell; no_client: the visit has no client on our records.

expected_technician_id.description: The technician the board showed the job with; null for a job in the tray.

expected_starts_at.description: The start the board showed the job with.

technician_id.description: Left out keeps the technician it has.

expected_technician_id.description: The technician the board showed the job with; null for a job in the tray.

expected_starts_at.description: The start the board showed the job with.

person.description: Whose visit it was, so ops can open their page and call them; null once they have been erased.

checked_in_at.description: Fact one: when the technician arrived, by his phone, held within bounds. The wait ran from here.

phone_checked_in_at.description: What the phone itself said, before the bounds; null when it said nothing.

received_at.description: When the check-in reached us: long after the phone's time means no signal, or a clock set back.

minutes_late.description: Minutes from the booked start to the check-in; negative when he was early.

distance_m.description: Fact two: how far from the address he was; null where the address had no coordinates and nothing was measured.

message_state.description: Fact three: what became of the day-before or arrival WhatsApp. none: nothing was queued; no_consent: not sent, the client never agreed to WhatsApp about visits; not_sent: skipped or failed; sent: no receipt came back; delivered.

message_delivered_at.description: When WhatsApp reported it delivered; null if it never did.

opened_at.description: When the case opened, and started waiting for ops.

due.description: When ops should have ruled: the Tasks board's allowance for a no-show, from opened_at.

NoShowCase.description: The three facts ops rule on, and nothing else.

reason.description: Required either way, and kept with the ruling (src/policy/decision-reasons.ts).

leave.description: Leave that has not ended yet, soonest first (ADR 0062).

to.description: Inclusive: a single day's leave has the same date twice.

jobs.description: The jobs already booked on those days, which the leave moves nowhere: ops move them on the dispatch board, and each waits on the Tasks board until they do (OPS-07).

note.description: Why, in ops' words. Never a medical detail.

overdue.description: How many are past their day in India, across every group.

truncated.description: More were waiting than one look reads (2000 a statement), so a count may be short.

count.description: How many are waiting in the group, all of them.

tasks.description: The longest wait first, at most 50.

Tasks.description: Derived at read time from the queues themselves; there is no tasks table.

id.description: The queued row's own id, so the task can be reached where it is decided.

person.description: Null for an erased client, whose record is gone.

detail.description: The one fact the group turns on: a piece's label, a fraud rule, a technician, a Books invoice, an FSM contact.

due.description: since plus the group's allowance, which ops set; 48 hours until they do.

date.description: India's calendar date the figures cover.

collected.description: In paise. Captured on the day: the board's "Collected today".

refunds_processing.description: In paise. Asked for on the day and not back with the client yet: "Refunds processing".

refunded.description: In paise. Processed by Razorpay on the day, which the board draws no figure of its own for.

charged.description: In paise. Kept from the client on the day: "Charges and no-shows", less the no-shows, which carry no amount.

no_shows_charged.description: How many no-shows ops ruled charged on the day. Counted and not added, because nothing records what one was charged (docs/open-points.md, item 57).

dispute.description: The charge under dispute, with the note ops write on it. Nothing records a dispute and no client can raise one, so this is always null (docs/open-points.md, item 57).

charges.description: No-shows and late cancellations, the earliest first.

OpsDayMoney.description: Derived at read time from the payments themselves; no total is kept.

id.description: The change's or the case's own id.

person.description: Null for a visit FSM never matched to one of our people.

amount.description: Null on a no-show: ops record the ruling and nothing records an amount, because the charge itself is applied at P2-M5.

at.description: When the client cancelled, or when ops ruled on the no-show.

visit_started_at.description: When the visit was to start.

change.description: How the client ended the visit; null on a no-show, where they ended nothing.

technician.description: Who attended and found nobody in; null on a late cancellation.

to.description: Exclusive: the day after the last one counted.

technicians.description: Every active technician, by name, including those who finished nothing.

TechniciansWork.description: Counted at read time from the appointments themselves.

timed_jobs.description: Of those, the ones the phone timed from Start to the outcome: what the averages are the mean of.

average_minutes.description: How long those took; null when the phone timed none of them.

average_planned_minutes.description: What the same jobs were planned to take, so the two can be read against each other.

skill.description: The board's "First fit" or "Service". Nothing records what a technician is trained for and the FSM user carries no such field, so this is always null (docs/open-points.md, item 59).

keys.description: null for one number, a list where the keys are fixed, "open" where ops name them.

default.description: The committed figure, in force until somebody sets one.

source.description: The module the default lives in.

item.description: A kind of visit, or one of the two late fees.

waiting.description: How many are on its waitlist.

to_alert.description: How many of them serving it would tell now: those who asked, and have not been told yet.

area.description: A better name for the area than its post office's. Left out, the name stays.

signed_in_as.description: A member of staff's e-mail, or a service token's ID.

sign_out.description: Access's logout path; null where no Access stands in front, as locally.
